claim.value: Absent invitations alone may fit several explanations.
claim.scope: Invitation absence considered without additional discriminating observations.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly identifies absent invitations alone as compatible with several explanations.

signal_basis.value: Inspection of account-level event sequences, with event completeness checked, reveals absent invitations without additional observations that distinguish competing explanations.
signal_basis.scope: Invitation absence alone in the onboarding event record; no inference about which explanation is true or prevalent.

provenance.rationale: P006 supplies the event-inspection operation and completeness check; P021 supplies invitation absence and its nondiscriminating scope.
The claim is supported within its explicit bounds without an unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Even accurately observed invitation absence does not uniquely identify why an account has not proceeded. Several explanations can produce the same absence. The claim asserts only this compatibility, so the described signal licenses it without establishing any particular cause.
uncertainty: Which explanation applies, and how common each explanation is, remains unresolved; neither is asserted by this claim.
